idea-plugin.name: FedRAMP OSCAL SSP Lint
idea-plugin.description:
16 checks on a system-security-plan JSON, in your editor, before a validator returns the package

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → FedRAMP OSCAL SSP Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 16 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/fedramp-oscal-ssp-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/fedramp-oscal-ssp-lint

action.text: FedRAMP OSCAL SSP Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run FedRAMP OSCAL SSP Lint on the file in the editor
